commits.subject: core: another pass on TSynThreadPool shuhtdown logic
commits.body: - should be safer and avoid most deadlock at shutdown
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: ensure TSynThreadPool POSIX queue is O(1)
commits.body:
- use a round-robin algorithm like TSynQueue instead of a moving array
- so the internal TLightLock is assured to be with almost no contention
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: all: fixes several locking issues
commits.body: - mostly introduced during previous commits, or even long-standing but never triggered
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: fixed TTunnelLocalThread.Create on BSD
commits.body: - where TOSLightLock is a TRtlCriticalSection which requires initialization
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: refined THttpPeerCrypt HTTP client lock
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: refined TSynThreadPool internal POSIX lock
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: optimized TTunnelLocalThread accept() step
commits.body: - benefit from an OS futex while waiting
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: core: some code refactoring with no functional change
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: lib: fixed TAlgoZstd context usage
commits.body:
- it was blocking on multi-thread
- this unit is clearly not finalized
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: crypt: fixed potential deadlock in TEccCertificateChain.ValidateItems
commits.body: - this method is now deliberly not thread safe and won't try to use ReadLock here
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez

commits.subject: net: new TWebSocketProtocol.IsSubprotocol/SetName methods
commits.body:
- to replace TWebSocketProtocol.SetSubprotocol which was not thread-safe
- with clear distinction between name checking and cloned instance setup
- both virtual to be properly overriden e.g. for synopse binary protocols
commits.author: Arnaud Bouchez
